jurisdiction.name: Bahamas
jurisdiction.constitutionalFoundation: Constitution of the Commonwealth of the Bahamas (1973). Final appellate court: Privy Council (UK).

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to make provision for the ownership of land in vertical dimension and for related matters.
primaryActs.summary: Strata regime for the Bahamas. Section 6 establishes the by-laws; section 14 the insurance trust; section 24 the rights of the body corporate.

primaryActs.shortTitle: Conveyancing and Law of Property Act
primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to consolidate the law of property and conveyancing in the Bahamas.
primaryActs.summary: Bahamas' equivalent of the UK LPA 1925. Section 54 grants relief against forfeiture.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the registration of title to land in the Bahamas.
primaryActs.summary: Modernised land-registration regime. Section 12 establishes the priority of registered interests; section 29 the rectification rules.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the regulation of housing in the Bahamas.
primaryActs.summary: Establishes the Housing Division; provides for rent dispute adjudication.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the development and regulation of tourism in the Bahamas.
primaryActs.summary: Indirect relevance for leasehold: tourism-resort zoning restrictions fall under this Act.

leadingCases.caseName: Paradise Island Leaseholders v Paradise Co
leadingCases.headnote: Quorum requirements for special assessment votes upheld; s.24 of the Condominium Act invalidates assessments without a quorum.

proceduralRules.title: Rules of the Supreme Court
proceduralRules.summary: Civil procedure rules in the Bahamas.

remedies.label: Body Corporate By-Law Challenge
remedies.description: Challenge to a by-law adopted without a quorum under s.6 of the Condominium Act.
